flatten_parameter: flatten a nevergrad Parameter into a list of named sub-parameters for inspection
list_data_parameter: list all Data instances in a nevergrad Parameter in standardized data order
analyze_parameter: analyze a nevergrad Parameter to get its determinism, continuity, order, and arity info
deterministic_sampling_context: use the deterministic_sampling context manager to force deterministic sampling on a Parameter
normalizer_transform: create a Normalizer to transform data between standardized space and normalized [0, 1] bounds
